data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall goal, GitHub lookup steps and email template right, but it omits the {blog} parameter and the open-new-tab step that finds the latest post (it says only "blog or pinned item"), makes the recipient a parameter when the true one is fixed, adds a Users filter step, and ends with "Send or discard" when the true workflow always discards and never sends, so it can't be automated reliably.
